name: Valid Parentheses (Stack)
description: Validates balanced bracket sequences using a stack. Equivalent to the array version but emphasizes the stack data structure.
aim: Check balanced brackets by pushing open brackets and verifying matching close brackets match the stack top.
howItWorks: For close bracket: if stack empty or top doesn't match → invalid
If loop ends and stack empty → valid

time.bestCase: First character is mismatched close bracket

complexity.spaceDescription: Stack holds at most n/2 elements

alternatives: Counter for single bracket type only
